verification: Every rate and effective date below was written from public rules without access to the official notices. Each row names the notice it comes from; verify each one against that notice before relying on it.

a_share.note: Assumed broker commission 0.025% with a 5 CNY minimum per order, applied to the commission only. Not a rule: set your broker's rate.

hk.note: Assumed broker commission 0.025% with a 5 HKD minimum per order. Not a rule: set your broker's rate and platform fees.

us.note: Assumed commission-free broker. Not a rule: set your broker's rate.

ignored: Exchange handling fee (经手费) and CSRC levy (证管费) are normally inside the broker commission and are not added.
Transfer-fee rules before 2015-08-01 (SSE charged per 1,000 shares) are not modelled; the 2015 row is used.

rows.source: Ministry of Finance / State Taxation Administration, 2008-09-18: securities transaction stamp duty 0.1% charged on the seller only from 2008-09-19. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
Ministry of Finance / State Taxation Administration Announcement 2023 No. 39: stamp duty on securities transactions halved from 2023-08-28. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
China Securities Depository and Clearing (CSDC): A-share transfer fee unified at 0.002% of turnover for Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2015-08-01. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
CSDC notice lowering the A-share transfer fee to 0.001% of turnover from 2022-04-29. From public rules, verify against the official notice.

ignored: Stamp duty relief for HK ETFs (from 2015-02-13) is not modelled: every HK symbol is charged as a stock.
CCASS settlement fee and broker platform fees are not added; put them in the commission if your broker charges them.

rows.source: Stamp Duty Ordinance (Cap. 117) Head 2(1): 0.1% of the consideration on each of buyer and seller (0.2% per transaction since 2001-09-01), rounded up to the next dollar. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
Stamp Duty (Amendment) Ordinance 2021 (2021-22 Budget): 0.13% on each side from 2021-08-01. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
2023 Policy Address: stamp duty on stock transfers back to 0.1% on each side from 2023-11-17. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
HKEX trading fee 0.005% of the consideration on each side (rate in force before 2023). From public rules, verify against the official notice.
HKEX trading fee raised to 0.00565% on each side from 2023-01-01. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
SFC transaction levy reduced from 0.003% to 0.0027% on each side from 2014-12-01. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
No FRC/AFRC transaction levy before 2022-01-01. From public rules, verify against the official notice.

Financial Reporting Council (Amendment) Ordinance 2019: FRC transaction levy 0.00015% on each side from 2022-01-01 (the FRC became the AFRC on 2022-10-01). From public rules, verify against the official notice.

ignored: FINRA Trading Activity Fee (TAF) on sells is not modelled (at most a few dollars per order).
SEC fee rates after the last row are assumed unchanged; the SEC resets the rate at least once per fiscal year.

rows.source: SEC Section 31 fee rate advisory, fiscal 2021: $5.10 per million dollars of sales. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
SEC Section 31 fee rate advisory, fiscal 2022: $22.90 per million from 2022-05-22. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
SEC Section 31 fee rate advisory, fiscal 2023: $8.00 per million from 2023-02-27. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
SEC Section 31 fee rate advisory, fiscal 2024: $27.80 per million from 2024-05-22. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
SEC Section 31 fee rate advisory, fiscal 2025 mid-year adjustment: $0.00 per million from 2025-05-14. From public rules, verify against the official notice.
